text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a part of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. One important area is text understanding, which allows machines to read and make sense of written words. NLP also makes translation possible, so people can communicate across different languages more easily. Another useful application is sentiment analysis, which helps companies discover whether customers feel positive or negative about a product. Finally, chatbots use NLP to answer questions and have simple conversations with users. Thanks to these technologies, computers can now interact with people in ways that feel more natural and helpful.
